==Usage==
To use this template, paste <code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>UserGA-restored|{{Var|article}}|{{Var|formatted name}}}}</code> into your user page.

===Required parameters===
#{{Para||{{Var|article}}}} The article name.

===Optional parameters===
#<li value="2">{{Para||{{Var|formatted name}}}} The display name of the article.</li>
#{{Para|oldicon}} A flag to use the [[:File:GA-Icon-retro.svg|old Good article icon]] when set to <code>1</code>.
